listed_quote.quote: The reorganizations of BlackRock Real Asset Equity Trust (NYSE:BCF) and BlackRock EcoSolutions Investment Trust (NYSE:BQR) into BlackRock Resources & Commodities Strategy Trust (NYSE:BCX)

announcement.quote: BlackRock Advisors, LLC announced today that the Boards of Trustees of several equity option closed-end funds approved the reorganizations outlined below.

deals.notes: BCF into BCX; approval not contingent on the BQR into BCX reorganization. Joint special meeting of BCF, BQR and BCX set for November 10, 2014 (reminder 425s through 2014-10-24). No excerpt states the outcome. The same press release also lists BQY into BDJ, a pair that does not involve this acquirer and is not recorded.
